Name: Cutscene Choice Indicator
Author: vesbmm
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Green indicator when there is no choice in the cutscene, orange when there is a choice. Light and simple mod, works with moded cutscenes.[/color][/size]

[i][color=#6aa84f]It is possible to change the indicator's position via the config file or through the settings with GenericModConfigMenu installed.[/color][/i]

[u][color=#ffd966]Tested only in the 1.6 and SMAPI 4.5.2[/color][/u]
[u][color=#ffd966]but generally there shouldn't be any problems...[/color][/u]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Nothing special, install with Vortex or just put it in the mod folder.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b][i]SMAPI[/i][/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b][i]GenericModConfigMenu (Optional)[/i][/b][/color][/*]
[/list]
[color=#e06666][b]Bugs may occur. In such cases, enable logging in the config file ("LogDetection": true) and submit feedback.[/b][/color]

Manifest.Name: Cutscene Choice Indicator
Manifest.Description: Shows an icon when the current event script contains a player choice command.
Manifest.Author: vesbmm
